name: Yunia
source:
Younger twin sister of [url=/c149378]Cordelia[/url]. Unlike her sister, she has a cold aura, but nevertheless attracts people. Loves to quote gained knowledge and put it into practice. Often engages in arguments with [url=/c149377]Debra[/url] and [url=/c149381]Eli[/url], finding their way of thinking frivolous. Able to point out things others wouldn't even notice.
